verdict.rationale: Stripe provides generic webhooks (docs-38) and a Dispute automation feature 'Smart Disputes' that automates evidence collection/submission (docs-40), plus platform-level AI agent tooling via MCP (docs-35, docs-36), which together could support an agent monitoring disputes and drafting responses. However, none of this is Terminal-specific, there's no explicit dispute-deadline webhook event or agent-draft-for-review workflow documented, only generic dashboard automation.
